doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: FR4: Users can update profile information and preferences. Profile management includes email, display name, profile picture, and user preferences like theme and notifications.

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: NextAuth.js 4.24.12 for session management. Session stored in secure HTTP-only cookie. Supabase Auth for OAuth providers. Session invalidation using Supabase Admin API auth.admin.signOut(userId).

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: Prisma ORM with PostgreSQL via Supabase. User model includes fields: id, email, name, avatar, themePreference, createdAt, updatedAt, lastLogin. Profile data stored in user table.

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: Supabase Storage for avatar images. Use avatars/ bucket for profile pictures. Image optimization: resize to max dimensions, compress, generate thumbnail.

doc.title: Epic Breakdown
doc.snippet: Profile page route: /profile or /settings/profile. Form components: ShadCN/UI form with react-hook-form. Image upload: multipart/form-data, store in Supabase Storage. API endpoint: PATCH /api/user/profile.

doc.title: UX Design Specification
doc.snippet: WCAG 2.1 Level AA compliance required. Mobile-first approach with breakpoints at 320px, 768px, 1024px, 1440px. Touch targets minimum 44px for mobile. Keyboard navigation support for all interactive elements.

doc.title: Previous Story Learnings
doc.snippet: Auth Infrastructure Available: NextAuth.js configured with OAuth providers. Session management helpers available at src/lib/auth/nextauth-helpers.ts. Validation Utilities: Email validation schemas available at src/lib/auth/validation.ts with RFC 5322 email validation. Form Components: ShadCN/UI Form components with react-hook-form integration already established.

constraint.description: Profile route must be in dashboard route group: src/app/(dashboard)/profile/page.tsx
Use ShadCN/UI form components with react-hook-form for all form inputs
Profile pictures must be stored in Supabase Storage avatars/ bucket
Email validation must use RFC 5322 standard from src/lib/auth/validation.ts
Email changes require verification and must invalidate all existing sessions using Supabase Admin API auth.admin.signOut(userId)
All forms must meet WCAG 2.1 Level AA compliance with minimum 4.5:1 color contrast ratio for text
Maintain minimum 80% test coverage for all new code. Use TDD approach: write tests before implementation

interface.name: GET /api/profile
interface.signature: GET /api/profile → { id, email, name, avatar, role, subscriptionTier, themePreference, createdAt, lastLogin }

interface.name: PATCH /api/profile
interface.signature: PATCH /api/profile { name?, themePreference? } → { success, profile, message }

interface.name: useProfile Hook
interface.signature: useProfile(): { profile, isLoading, error, fetchProfile, updateProfile, clearError }

interface.name: User Model
interface.signature: User { id, email, name, avatar, themePreference, createdAt, updatedAt, lastLogin }

tests.standards: Testing standards require minimum 80% test coverage for all new code. Use TDD approach following Red-Green-Refactor cycle. Test types include: unit tests for components and utilities, integration tests for profile update flow, E2E tests for complete profile management flow, and accessibility tests using @axe-core/playwright. All tests should verify WCAG 2.1 AA compliance. Profile testing should cover complete flow (view → edit → save → verify), avatar upload, email change verification, and preference updates. Image upload testing should verify file validation (size, format), image compression, thumbnail generation, and storage upload. Security testing should verify session invalidation after email change, authentication requirements, and authorization (users can only update own profile).
